declarations.description:
Disclosures let users show and hide a section of related content.

The headless tier owns structure, accessibility wiring, and state. It ships
no CSS and references no tokens: styling is the styled tier's job. Consumers
who want to bring their own styling entirely can use this tier directly.

`open`, `defaultOpen`, `isOpen`, and `setOpen` come from the `WithOpen` mixin
and resolve into this component's manifest automatically, because
`@helix-io/core` publishes one and the analyzer runs with
`dependencies: true`.

Content stays mounted when closed and is hidden by the styled tier's CSS.
Unmounting it made an open/close transition impossible, and `hidden` is
`display: none`, which cannot transition either. `inert` keeps closed content
out of the tab order and the accessibility tree without removing it from the
box tree.

The event is declared here rather than inferred. It is dispatched through a
generic helper, and the analyzer can only record the parameter identifier of
a dynamic dispatch, not the name it resolves to at runtime.
declarations.name: HelixDisclosureBase

members.description:
Whether the element is open. Setting this puts the element into
controlled mode: the consumer owns the value from that point on.
members.name: open

members.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled use. Ignored once `open` is set.
members.name: defaultOpen

members.description: The resolved open state, whichever mode the element is in.
members.name: isOpen

members.description:
Mirrors the resolved state onto the host as `data-open`.

`open` only reflects in controlled mode, so styling on `:host([open])`
silently does nothing for uncontrolled consumers. Presentation needs one
selector that is true whenever the element is actually open, in either
mode.
members.name: reflectResolvedState

members.description:
Requests an open-state change. In uncontrolled mode the element updates
itself; in controlled mode it only notifies and waits for the consumer.
members.name: setOpen

members.description:
Prepends the shadow-root reset to every subclass's styles, so no component
has to remember to include it.
members.name: finalizeStyles

members.description:
Dispatches a composed, bubbling CustomEvent. Kebab-case names map to React
`onFooBar` props through the wrapper generator, so event names are part of
the public API and should be treated as such.
members.name: emit

events.description: Fired when the disclosure is opened or closed. Carries `{ open: boolean }`. In controlled mode this is the only signal; the element does not update itself.
events.name: open-change

attributes.description:
Whether the element is open. Setting this puts the element into

attributes.name: open

attributes.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled use. Ignored once `open` is set.
